Is dead.
Niger State Governor. Mohammed Umaru Bago reportedly announced the demise of the notable educationist and recounted the deceased’s contributions to human capital development.
He noted that Prof. Ndagi was an elder statesman, an academic whose impact earned him the traditional title of Wazirin Makaranta Nupe.
